LanguageData.OverHaulers_VerboseBreakdown: Expand All Details on Info Cards
LanguageData.OverHaulers_VerboseBreakdown_Desc: Forces pawn info cards to display every single body part and organ, even if completely healthy and normal.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_VerboseBreakdown_Tooltip: If checked, shows every single body part on a pawn's info page, even if they are perfectly healthy and normal.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_DevStressTestAllFauna_Desc: High-load population benchmarking override. When enabled, 100% of biological fauna (livestock, wild animals, vermin, predators) are forced through the OverHaulers solver, SoA workspaces, and dynamic cache pipeline regardless of pack animal status. Designed to stress-test cache capacity, TTL scaling, and zero-allocation throughput across large populations.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_ReportMetricsInterval_Toolti: Configure how often (in game-hours) the cumulative performance and cache efficiency report is printed to the log. Set to 0 to completely disable automatic reports.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_ReportContent_Desc: Configure which telemetry sections are compiled and dispatched to the console log during periodic reports.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogQueryMetrics_Desc: Tracks overall capacity query volume and compares main-thread game queries against off-thread background worker pathfinding requests.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogCacheMetrics_Desc: Tracks cache hit ratios, hits, and solver recalculations across both main-thread evaluations and background thread queries.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogSnapshotTableMetrics_Desc: Reports 4096-slot atomic hash table load factor, dual-tier cache parity, linear probe depths (average & peak), displacement overflows, and SeqLock concurrency retries.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogLifecycleMetrics_Desc: Reports reactive cache invalidations, combat burst damage debouncer efficiency, and active pawn lifecycle purges.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogWorkspaceMetrics_Desc: Reports active thread-static workspace memory scratchpads allocated across main and worker threads.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogSafetyFloorClamps_Desc: Buffers and lists pawns whose calculated mass capacity dropped below the safety floor and was clamped.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogPawnEvictions_Desc: Buffers and lists the unique Thing IDs of pawns evicted from memory due to death, despawn, or long-term inactivity.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_CacheInactivityEvictionHours: Configures how many game-hours a pawn's capacity cache entry can remain unqueried before being evicted from memory. (1 game-hour = {0} ticks, {1} hours = 1 game day).
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Benchmark_Desc: Measures how long Over Haulers takes to solve a pawn's caravan mass capacity from scratch on this machine with your current mod list, using test pawns only (your colonists and caches are never touched). Results are synthetic and cover Over Haulers only. May take a few seconds depending on your hardware and current mod list; the window may stutter briefly while it runs.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Benchmark_Copied: Benchmark report copied to the clipboard.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Benchmark_Startup: Topology compile: {0} ms for {1} body definitions (largest: {2}, {3} parts)
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Benchmark_RampHeader: Estimated cost of re-solving N pawns from scratch in one go
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Benchmark_Notes: Percentages are shares of a 60 fps frame (16.7 ms). Normal play uses cached results, which are far cheaper than a from-scratch solve; a full re-solve only follows health, gear or settings changes. "GC runs" should be 0. Compare runs on the same machine rather than across different ones.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Benchmark_TableHeader: Background snapshot table (lock-free reads used by pathfinding threads)
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Benchmark_TableSingle: Single-thread read: {0} ns (hit), {1} ns (miss) - {2} pawns resident in a {3}-slot table
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Benchmark_TableNotes: Reads come from background threads while the main thread keeps writing. A retry means a read overlapped a write and was repeated; a timeout means it gave up and safely returned the neutral fallback. The saturating writer is an artificial worst case far beyond real play, which performs only a handful of writes per frame.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Desc: Runs Over Haulers' built-in correctness checks on this game install: the lock-free snapshot table (against private copies, so live data is untouched), the core collections, every loaded body definition, and the solver on test pawns. Usually finishes within a second, depending on your hardware and mod list. Failures are also listed in the exported benchmark report, so include it when reporting a bug.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Check_NeutralDefau: Unknown and non-positive IDs return neutral defaults
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Check_ClusterEvict: Colliding keys survive eviction in any order
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Check_RandomAgains: Matches a reference model under random insert/evict
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Check_Saturation: Saturated probe window displaces one entry per overflow
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Check_ConcurrentRe: Concurrent readers never observe torn values
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Check_UniqueList: Unique list add, merge, clear and enumeration
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Check_TopologyInte: Every compiled body template is structurally sound
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Check_WoundsNeverI: Amputation and trauma never increase mass capacity
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Note_ConcurrentRea: {0} writer cycles checked against {1} concurrent reads
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Note_TopologyParti: {0} templates verified, {1} bodies produced no template
LanguageData.OverHaulers_SelfCheck_Skip_NoSubject: No default test subject is available.
